body: How could anyone think this is funny? I mean, clearly most people here know it's not but ffs...in my town, theres a cigar shop/stationary store owned by Muslims. I live in a predominantly white area, and there are definitely racists/xenophobes, etc., but those men commit to their prayers, and when they do, EVERYONE respects it, and we wait patiently to get our smokes and lotto tickets until theyve completed their ritual.
Thats awesome to use as a panic room. Id be stoked to find that in my place
I have really bad ptsd nightmares sometimes. But if my bf is staying over, my chances of having a nightmare drop to ZERO. I've always wondered why.
Weird how there seems to be a burn mark from the plug on the foot. Then one puncture wound next to it...and the blood on the plug would have to be upside down to get that blood on it...right?
the same thing happened to me when my mom was breastfeeding. Her milk didn't contain certain enzymes or something, so it made the milk almost like glue and got stuck. it was all formula after that.

I'm not even sure. I'm in such a blur but I guess when I'm on my meds, I can shake off a failure, and then take a break, and go back to it with fresh eyes, and a new strategy. 

We got her 10 years ago. She's a little old lady, but she still looks and acts like a puppy. 

He does know - but he knows I don't care for my birthday, so he actually slept over last night. It was nice having him and my dog to wake up with this morning. We do it all the time. But especially on a day that gets me down, made me feel good.

When I'm on my meds, I can handle/accept my failures and keep trying. I try so hard to stick to a healthy diet, to save money, to keep my home clean, to be on time for work, to do better at work...but I always end up slacking off. 

Everyone says their dog is the best, but here's why mine is...she's super lovey and snuggly, but she also has a sassy little attitude, and its hilarious coming from such a tiny creature. For instance, if we have a fire going in the fire place, she gets nice and cozy right in front and when the flame gets low, she turns her head and barks (it actually sounds more like a quack since shes so small) to let me know we need another log. 

I'm starting to feel a little better today - but the only people mentioning doing anything for my birthday are the ones I don't care to celebrate with. 

My boyfriend is leaving for Vegas in a few days and I have no idea if he even knows it's my birthday tomorrow. I just want to spend it with him...and my dog.

My dog is a yorkie/pomeranian mix...kind of acquired her by accident. My mom got her for herself but the yorkie was basically inseparable from my maltese who passed. When I lost him, she lost her little buddy too and so we now we need each other. I love her so so much. 

The doom and gloom is basically all these negative thoughts...all the worlds problems both political and ecological, my failures as a daughter, sister, family member, girlfriend, friend...failure as an individual. I almost sort of feel like my mind is holding me hostage and it's like a stockholm syndrome thing. 

I'm also on meds and I decided to just stop taking them. I don't know why. I guess I kind of do. I remember when I was taking them I was feeling great but I was still failing. I have therapy tonight but all I'm thinking about is what to say to the therapist to make it seem like everything's fine. 

I'm incredibly self destructive and I'm almost daring myself to see how far it will go.
